description: Attach the payer's EIP-712 PaymentAuthorization signature to a quoted payment intent. The signature is produced locally by the payer's wallet; it authorizes up to maximumTotalAuthorized, expiring at expiresAt. No funds move until submit_payment.

payer_signature.description: EIP-712 signature (0x, 65 bytes) of the PaymentAuthorization typed data, signed by payer_wallet.

payment_intent_id.description: Payment intent ID returned by quote_payment.

name: authorize_payment

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Authorize a payment
